messages:
Elaine: Heads up — prod runtime p99 spiked from ~120ms to ~1.2s starting ~02:14 UTC. p95 unchanged. Dashboard: https://grafana.internal/r/ABCD. Anyone on call?
Carlos: seeing it too, same cluster (us-west-2). Throughput dropped briefly. Microbatching metrics look weird — average microbatch size collapsed.
Mei: quick look at profiler: kernel_selector started choosing fallback_fused a lot more after 02:10. KV cache miss rate jumped ~3x.
Mei: paste logs:
```
kernel_selector chosen=fallback_fused reason=kv_miss
kvcache_hit=0.24 kvcache_miss=0.76
microbatch_size=1 admission_queue=120
```
Derek: that suggests admission controller throttled batches -> smaller microbatches -> worse kernel path -> tail blowup. Could be a recent scheduler change.
deploy-bot: Deploy: runtime-scheduler service sha=abc123 by @Carlos at 02:10 UTC (canary) :rocket: 
Elaine: 02:10 deploy matches timing. Did we enable new admission heuristics in that PR?
Carlos: yes, PR #487 added latency-aware throttling: it reduces target batch_size when observed latency > threshold. It also added a kv_penalty term but I think weighting is off.
Mei: benchmark numbers pre/post:
- before (fused): p50=18ms p99=80ms
- after (fallback_fused): p50=40ms p99=900ms
So fallback is much worse at tail.
Carlos: looking at admission logs — policy dropped microbatch_floor to 1 for many shards because it assumed cache misses were transient. That combined with fallback kernel killed throughput.
Elaine: can we rollback the deploy quickly?
Carlos: starting rollback to sha=def789 (02:00) for runtime-scheduler. Also adding extra kernel_selector debug logs to trace reason codes.
Derek: doing a staging repro: warm KV cache vs cold. With cold KV and microbatch=1, latency matches prod tail. With microbatch=8, fused kernel selected and tail is ~90ms.
Mei: short-term fix: tweak admission weights -> increase kv_cache_weight and set microbatch_floor=4. I'll prepare a hotpatch.
Carlos: patch applied in canary and rollback promoted. Monitoring now.
Elaine: initial signals look good — p99 back under 120ms on canary. Great work. :thumbsup:
Derek: follow-ups: add metric kernel_switch_rate per minute, alert when kvcache_miss_ratio > 0.5, and add circuit-breaker in admission controller to avoid repeated kernel swaps.
Carlos: created INFRA-9123 with rollback timeline, RCA notes, and the three follow-ups.
Mei: also adding a unit/regression test in scheduler harness to simulate noisy-kv and ensure microbatch doesn't collapse to 1. Will run nightly.
Elaine: thanks everyone. We'll keep this thread open until full prod stable and ticket closed. Post any odd traces here.
